properties.description: On August 26, 2026, a major flash flood caused by a glacier collapse struck Rasuwa District in northern Nepal after a sudden and intense surge of water entered the Bhote Koshi River from the Tibet (China) side at approximately 9:15 AM local time. The event rapidly affected the border areas of Timure and Rasuwagadhi before moving downstream towards Syabrubesi and the Trishuli River corridor.
properties.title: Nepal-Flooding-Aug-2026
